tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (shrī)༄༅/ /mgon po bing dmar gyi gtor chog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru we ma hā kā lā ya/dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bing dmar la
(shrī)༄༅/ /mgon po bing dmar gyi gtor chog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru we ma hā kā lā ya/dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bing dmar la

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// mgon po bing dmar gyi gtor chog ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru we ma hā kā lā ya/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bing dmar la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ legs par bshams pa'i gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ bhrūm̐ ām̐ dzrīṃ kham̐ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga/ de rnams kyi steng du/ zla ba'i dbus su rdo rje phyed pa oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ rdo rje 'bru gsum zla ba dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ste 'dres pas zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mdung dang ral gri mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshub cing me rlung gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus su gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma la/ dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las gri gug mthing nag yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po bing dmar po sku mdog dmar nag srin po khros pa'i cha lugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang ldan pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba rnam par gtsigs nas ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ ha ha'i gad rgyang gis sa gsum 'dar bar byed pa/

phyag g.yas nor bus mtshan pa'i tsandan gyi bing chen po 'phyar stabs su 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pas dgra snying dron mo 'phar bzhin pas khengs pa'i lcags kyi spar bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sku la dar nag po'i 'jol ber dgu brtsegs gsol zhing gser skeg rin chen sked la bcings pa/ zhabs la sag ti'i lh+wam gsol ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ dug sbrul nag po'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ mi mgo skam rlon gyi thod dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas dam nyams kyi steng na bro brdung ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i mdun du/ las mkhan mon pa nag po/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa dgra snying gis gang ba gtso bo la stob pa/ kha gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ mtha' skor kun tu ye shes kyi mgon po sprin ltar 'thibs pa/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po rlung ltar 'tshubs pa/ las kyi mgon po glog ltar 'khyugs pa/ sprul pa'i pho nya thog ltar 'bebs shing snang srid kyi ma mo dang*/ gshin rje dregs byed du mas bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// ye shes mgon po spyan 'dren no// thugs dam thugs rjes brtser dgongs la// bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drang*/ nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/

rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams dang bdag gis lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa rnams dang*/ 'khor dang longs spyod du bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i phrin las thams cad myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dam la bzhag rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ mgon po'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ dhu dhu swā hā bhrūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ nyer spyod dang*/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod phul/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i phrin las bcol la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ rnga brdung zhing*/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs mchog he ru ka /ma rungs bdud kyi dpung 'joms phyir// srung ma'i dbang por rnam sprul pa// ye shes mgon po khyod la bstod// bskal pa'i me rlung 'khyil pa'i klong*// shugs drag mtshon cha'i bu yug 'tshubs// gru gsum 'bar ba'i pho brang dbus// rnam par rol pa khyod la bstod// rab 'jigs srin po khros pa'i gzugs// dmar nag nyi ma bye ba'i gzi// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs khrag la dges// khros pa'i spyan gsum g.yo la bstod// phyag g.yas tsandan bing chen pa// nam mkhar 'phyar zhing brdabs pa yis// bdud dmag nyi khri rab khros nas// nag phyogs phye mar 'thag la bstod// dam nyams snying dmar khrag don gyis// rab gang spar bu g.yon na 'dzin// g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang brjid pa'i gar// bstan dgra'i snying gar rol la bstod// brjid ldan dar nag 'jol ber dang*// sbrul dang rin chen rus pas brgyan// dpa' gtum stag gi sham thabs kyis// rnam par sgeg pa khyod la bstod// thugs kyi sprul pa dgra bo'i gshed// gri gug rab 'phyar dgra snying za// mdog nag drag po ma rungs pa// las kyi mgon po khyed la bstod// ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi// tshul 'dzin mthu stobs mtha' yas pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs// sprul pa yang sprul bcas la bstod// ye shes mgon po 'khor dang bcas// tshur byon sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin// dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma bzhes// bstan pa'i dgra bo myur du sgrol// khyad par zhwa lu'i gtsug lag khang*// dge 'dun sde dang sbyin bdag bcas// mi nyams 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*// 'gran zla kun las rgyal bar mdzod// bdag gi gnas dgon longs spyod dang*// 'khor 'bangs slob mar bcas pa kun// bcol lo bstod do dus kun tu// srung skyob sba bar mdzad du gsol// bdag dang bdag gi phyogs rnams la// gnod par sems pa'i dgra dang bgegs// de dag dpung dang bcas pa kun// ma thogs myur ba nyid du sgrol// mdor na ji ltar bcol ba yi// phrin las thams cad myur sgrub ste// bstan dang bstan 'dzin ma lus pa// phyogs dus kun tu rgyas par mdzod// ces pas bstod cing phrin las bcol/

rgyas par na/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i bstod pa sogs byas shing*/ mjug gi cho ga spyi dang mthun par bya'o// zhes dpal zhwa lu'i chos grwa chen po'i bka' srung beng dmar po'i mchod gtor gyi rim pa 'di yang*/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa sogs yon tan du mas rgyud bltams shing*/ sde dang bstan pa'i khur mi lhod pa slob dpon chen po rnam sras pa dang*/ rgyud sde rab 'byams la blo'i snang ba thob pa'i bla chen sangs rgyas seng ge bas bskul ba'i ngor/ btsun pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos lcags mo bya lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer dgu'i srod la dpal zhwa lu gser khang gi gtsug lag khang du bgyis pa phrin las thams cad thogs med du gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /'di'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ kha sarpā ṇi/ grub chen mi tra dzo ki/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ sku zhang chos rje nam mkha'i mtshan can/ sku zhang nam mkha'i 'bum/ mkhas pa tsand+ra shrī/ 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen mchog grub dpal 'bar/ rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa/ des bdag mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dpal mgon bing dmar po'i skong phrin bzhugs so// 'dir dpal mgon beng dmar po'i gtor chog mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa bzhin nyams su blangs thog thugs dam bskul ba'i rim pa 'di bzhin bya'o// oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang dur khrod chen po ha ha rgod pa sogs dang mtshungs pa'i dbus su skong rdzas rnams rakta'i mchod yon/ dbang po lnga'i me tog sha chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/

mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ mi rkang gling bu'i rol mo la sogs pa sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad gang zhing mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dges par byed pa'i mchod sprin zad mi shes par gyur cig oṃ sarba bitpū ra pū ra nas spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gis// rang bzhin zhi bas gdul bar mi nus par// rab 'jigs srin po khros pa'i skur bzhengs pa// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// pho rgyud dgra lha'i gtso bo mgon po bing*// mo rgyud srung ma'i gtso mo re ma ti// lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la kā li ye sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas rnams la// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin mtha' yas pa// sa dang nam mkha' ma lus gang ba 'di// bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung du gsol// bdud rtsi rnam lnga sgyur ba yis// dmar chen khrag gi arghaṃ dang*// bstan pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba yi// dbang po lnga yi me tog dang*// dur khrod sol me la bsregs pa'i// sha chen spos kyi dud sprin 'khrigs// rkang gi tshil bu sna tshogs dang*// zhun chen gsal ba'i mar me sbar// sha khrag mkhris chen sogs sbyar ba'i// dmar nag khrag gi dri chab 'khyil// dpal bshos zur gsum khrag gis byugs// ma hā māṃ sa'i zhal zas spungs// thod rnga gsang ba'i rnge'u chung*// mi rkang gling bu rol mo dang*// gzhan yang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// rin chen sna bdun bkra shis kyi// rdzas dang rtags brgyad lha mi'i nor// phyi nang gsang ba'i skong rdzas dang*// rta nag rlung gi shugs 'chang can// khyi nag snying dkar mthu rtsal can// g.yag rgod mun pa'i kha dog can// lug nag rwa bzhi 'khyil ba can// stong gsum khyon mnyam bde skyong mar// sbyangs rtogs sbar ba'i 'chi med bcud// zag med bde stong sman rag dang*// dmar chen ba liṃ rgya mtsho yis// dgra bgegs zhi ba'i dbyings su bsgral// sha khrag nang khrol rus rkang sogs// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa// drag po'i mchod rdzas 'di rnams kyis// ye shes mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*// dpal ldan bing gi thugs dam bskang*// brag lha mgon po'i thugs dam bskang*// legs ldan mgon po'i thugs=

/rtsis mgon chen po'i= /ma gcig lha mo'i= /'khor tshogs bye ba'i= thugs dam bskangs shing dgyes pa yis// nyams chags ma lus dag gyur nas// bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde// spyi dang khyad par zhwa lu'i gnas// bsrung skyob spel ba'i phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dang rje btsun spyan ras gzigs// mi tra dzo ki lo chen byams pa'i dpal// bsod nams dbang phyug sems dpa' chen po dang*// rin chen seng ge tshad ma'i skyes bu pa// thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston yab sras sogs// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde// bka' bsgos dam bzhag gnyer du gtad pa bzhin// sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du// dpal ldan zhwa lu'i gnas rten mchod rdzas sogs// bsrung zhing gong nas gong du spel ba dang*// 'gro kun bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod// deng dus las 'bras zab mo khyad bsad nas// dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor la 'bags pa sogs// dad ldan rnams kyis sbyar ba'i mchod pa'i sprin// nyams chags gtong ba'i gnod byed zhi bar mdzod// hūm̐/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur nas// khas blangs ji bzhin bslab khrims nyams pa sogs// nyes ltung dri mas phog pa mthol lo bshags// khyad par bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig las 'das te// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor la sogs pa// dus su ma bsgrubs nongs tshogs mthol lo bshags// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la// mi dang mi min 'tshe ba'i nad dang gdon// bar chad mtshan ltas ngan pa la sogs pa// ma lus bsrungs shing bzlog par mdzad du gsol// yul phyogs dmag 'khrug mu ge lo nyes sogs// 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// skye 'gro kun kyang bde skyid dpal 'byor kun// yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod// gtsug lag khang 'di skyong phyir 'gro ba kun// dbang du bsdus shing dbang phyug yon tan 'phel// dam can srung mas bdud phung tshar bcad nas// bsam don thams cad lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// ces dpal mgon bing chen po'i skong phrin phrin las myur 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni zhwa lu'i dngul gdung lha khang du gnyer gtad mgon po'i rten gsum 'dzugs skabs btsun pa blo gsal ri khrod pas rnga chen zhes pa chu pho byi lo sa ga zla ba'i dmar cha shis pa'i rgyal ba dang po'i nyin sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni zur rin chen blo bzang mkhyen rab kyis bgyis pa'o// maṅga laṃ//

༈ /dpal mgon bing gi rjes gnang gi yi ge bzhugs so// mgon po bing dmar gyi rjes gnang la/ gtor ma zur gsum che ba gcig gi mdun du chung ba gcig gi mthar mtheb skyus bskor ba mda' dar sogs kyis brgyan/ thod chang dang*/ bing gi phyag mtshan dang*/ 'bul gtor zur gsum pa'i mdun du mchod pa sogs spyi ltar bsham/ slob dpon gyis phyag rdor sogs yi dam gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa yan bya/ mdun gyi gtor ma dbang rdzas sogs gtor chog ltar gyi mdun bskyed bstod pa yan rgyas par bya/ maṇḍal/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa dang*// log 'dren bgegs rnams tshar bcad phyir// mgon po'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slar yang rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ dngos gzhi slob dpon la gsol gdab byas pas thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis slob ma stong par sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs mdung dang ral gri mtshon cha'i zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i bar gyis mgon po mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ slob dpon bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa bstim zhing spos rol bya'o// de nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rjes gnang la/ gtor ma mgon por gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag pas/ de las mgon po'i sku gcig chad/ slob ma'i spyi bor zhugs pas mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po yi// ye shes dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// bu khyod la ni dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ dhu dhu swā hā/ bhrūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ yang thod chang mgon por gsal ba mgrin par bzhag cing*/

de las mgon po gcig chad/ mgrin par thim pas/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ bdud rtsi lce la blug cing*/ dpal ldan mgon po sogs kyi tshigs bcad brjod cing*/ sngags kyi mthar/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ yang bing mgon por gsal ba snying gar bzhag cing*/ de las mgon po'i sku gcig chad/ snying gar thim pas thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dpal ldan mgon po sogs dang sngags kyi mthar/ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ yang gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la g.yas su bing dang*/ g.yon du thod chang gtad de/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod cing bka' bsgo rgyas par byas pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan mgon po sogs tshigs bcad dang sngags kyi mthar/ gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa swā/ slob dpon yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng zhal nas thon/ slob ma mgon por gsal ba'i zhal nas snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mthar 'khod pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas/ sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs kyis me tog dor/ slob dpon gyis thod phreng spyi bor bzhag cing*/ dpal ldan mgon po'i tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags mthar karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hā sogs bya/ de nas gtso bos sogs dang*/ maṇḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi ltar bya'o// rjes yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs dang*/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs spyi ltar bya'o// gsal byed lhan thabs 'di'ang bande dbang rab kyis bgyis pa'o// ༈ /'di'i rjes gnang gi gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ kha sarpā ṇi/ grub chen mi tra dzo ki/ khro phu lo tsā ba/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu sems dpa' chen po/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ thugs sras sems dpa' chen po/ sku zhang chos rje nam mkha'i mtshan can/ sku zhang nam mkha' 'bum/ mkhas mchog tsand+ra shrī/

'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen mchog grub dpal 'bar/ rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'phags mchog byams pa skal bzang*/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ khyab bdag mkhan chen byang gling pa chen po rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma mgon po ngag dbang blo gsal mchog ldan dpal bzang po'i zhabs drung du/ chos rje smon lam lhun grub pas gsan/ yang na/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang*/ sku zhang bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa shākya seng ge/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub/ chos rje smon lam lhun grub/ rje btsun blo bzang mkhas btsun/ byang gling 'jam dpal tshul khrims/ byams pa smon lam bsam gtan/ khyab bdag ye shes dpal 'byor la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang*/ dam tshig gi rim pa las ma 'da' bar/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi srung skyob tshul bzhin du mdzad nas/ 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzod cig 'di rje bla ma'i gsung lags/ maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
